What is the Difference Between Residential Elevators vs Commercial Elevators?
Hero Image: AEM Assets - Eco Efficient Elevators
Elevators have become an essential part of modern buildings, but not all elevator systems are designed for the same purpose. An elevator installed in a private villa has very different requirements from one operating in a busy office tower or shopping mall.

What are Residential Elevators?
AEM Assets - Girl and boy outside in residential area
Residential elevators are designed for private homes, villas, duplex residences, and low-rise apartment buildings. Their primary purpose is to improve accessibility, convenience, and mobility within the home.

FAQs
What is the difference between residential and commercial elevators?
Residential elevators are designed for homes and low-rise residential properties, while commercial elevators are built for offices, hotels, hospitals, and retail spaces.
Which type of elevator is faster: residential or commercial?
Commercial elevators are usually faster because they serve larger buildings and operate under higher passenger demand.
